instruction: A candid studio photograph captured in a medium close-up from a high angle. Against a plain white background, the woman with straight brown hair (R1) on the left wraps her arm around the shoulder of the woman with curly dark hair (R2) who sits on the right. Both women have their eyes closed, leaning close together in an intimate, quiet embrace. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a gentle, serene mood with a neutral color palette.

R1 and R2 lean close together with eyes closed
R2 sits beside R1 while receiving the shoulder embrace
